title: Dispatch: opus:F-09 generalization under amendment A3 (attempt 4, gpt-6-sol)
description:
Attempt 4 of the opus:F-09 legacy-row generalization. **Authority: docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md including the NEW Amendment A3 (§3, after R4) and invariant 12**, committed on the integration branch as 92222762. Read A3 in full first; it replaces the attempt-3 content standard, which was withdrawn (it required per-entry statements of what Eshyra does not track — an unbounded negative space ADR 0020 §3 rejects). Read the notes on eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4.1/.2/.3 for history; where they conflict with A3, A3 wins.

Worktree/branch: .worktrees/eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4.4 on branch eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4.4 = integration branch (A3) + cherry-pick of attempt 2's commit 742651c5. Build on it; `npm ci` first. Attempt 3's partial WIP (branch eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4.3, commit 991d595a) is reference only.

## Keep from attempt 2 (reviewed, accepted)
Owner-module layout (entries directly in src/rules/ruleAdjudicationContext.ts and ruleKnownLimits.ts), row-specific R0 comments, the materializer's single-definition + dual-channel projection, the ledger/implemented changes (rule:feats, rule:customizing-a-background → implemented, no bindings), the eight ADR 0018 `deferred` statements (incl. rule:experience-points), rule:suffocating and rule:channel-divinity exactly as on origin/main.

## Do (per A3)
1. **Adjudication context — positive tool mapping only.** Re-derive EVERY entry (attempt 2's ~107 + the 3 slice entries):
   - Keep an entry only if at least one registered tool other than lookup_rules carries state or resolution this rule governs. Read each candidate tool's description in packages/core/src/orchestrator/tool*.ts to confirm what it actually does.
   - dmContext = how the rule maps onto those tools: which tool, for what, and the rule-specific input (e.g. "Pass the degree-of-cover bonus to resolve_check as a declared modifier"). 1–2 sentences. NO statement of what Eshyra does not do, NO generic "the DM decides/adjudicates" prose, NO restating the rule text, never "retrieve/consult".
   - tools: every tool named in dmContext is listed and every listed tool other than lookup_rules is named in dmContext. Keep lookup_rules in the list (existing convention).
   - Otherwise DELETE the entry (R0 retired: the legacy model-adjudicated-supported label migrates nothing). Expect most pure-prose rows (movement modes, senses, spell components, etc.) to be deleted.
   - Slice entries — supervisor drafts; verify each tool's semantics against its description and correct wording only if a draft misdescribes a tool:
     • rule:cover — tools [lookup_rules, resolve_check]: "Pass the bonus for the target's degree of cover to resolve_check as a declared modifier to AC or to the Dexterity saving throw."
     • rule:opportunity-attacks — tools [lookup_rules, spend_turn_resource, resolve_check]: "Spend the attacker's reaction with spend_turn_resource, then resolve the opportunity attack with resolve_check."
     • rule:charges — tools [lookup_rules, spend_usage, restore_usage, reset_usage]: "Spend an item's charges with spend_usage, regain them with restore_usage, and apply its recharge with reset_usage; the item record carries its charge maximum and reset economy."
2. **Known limits — trap criterion.** Re-evaluate every non-deferred limit (attempt 2's partial rows incl. armor-guidance, conflict, crafting, lifestyle expenses, practicing a profession, researching, self-sufficiency, selling treasure, special weapons, training, weapon properties, wizard spellbook). Keep one only if a specific clause is one that an existing Eshyra tool or tracked state participates in, where using that tool/state as it stands would contradict or silently omit the clause; the R0 comment must name that tool/state (path + symbol) and the clause. Rewrite the statement to that clause and what to do about it (as rule:suffocating does). Otherwise delete it (no tool touches it → not a known limit; adjudicated from the text by default). Keep registered findingIds. Examples to reason from, not conclusions: weapon-properties ammunition vs resolve_check attacks may qualify; crafting/training/researching with no tool involvement likely do not; armor-guidance depends on whether any Eshyra state/tool presents or consumes an armor class — check.
3. **Audit projection.** Add RuleCoverageStatus `no-runtime-statement`: an engine-procedure key that is neither authored-implemented nor in any runtime channel materializes with that status and no findingId. The materializer still rejects any authored non-implemented row. The ENGINE_PROCEDURE_COVERAGE key set is unchanged. Update report/consumers of the status union (buildRuleDispositionReport etc.) so the new status is counted and never labelled unsupported/safe.
4. **Validators (permanent — channel contract, invariant 12).** validateRuleAdjudicationContext rejects: no tool other than lookup_rules; a listed tool (≠ lookup_rules) not named in dmContext; a registered tool name appearing in dmContext but not listed; dmContext containing "Eshyra does not" / "Eshyra doesn't". Keep the existing registered-tool and findingId checks.
5. **Invariant 4/12 test (permanent):** for every adjudication-context and known-limit entry, no run of 8+ consecutive words (lower-cased, punctuation-normalized) of its dmContext/statement appears in that record's source text in the committed pack. Measure runtime; keep only if well under a second.
6. **Tests**: update ruleDispositions / ruleAwareness / ledger tests to the new data; do not weaken any assertion that is still true; where A3 retires a claim, cite A3 + the row's evidence in notes. Permanent slice evidence in tools.test.ts / ruleAwareness.test.ts must keep passing or follow the rewritten slice text (same claims). Discovery probe/intervention suites green with no budget changes.

## Completion report (bd update --append-notes)
Computed counts (script): adjudication entries kept/deleted, known limits kept/deleted, audit rows by status. List every KEPT adjudication entry key with its tools; list every KEPT known limit with its trap (tool/state + clause); list deleted known limits with one-line reason. Then verify:worktree, commit on the branch, close.

Disjointness: do not touch importer/pack/relationship files or docs/design/* (A3 is already written; if A3 is unworkable somewhere, stop and record why on this bead). PR #595 (condition relationships) is separate.

Kept known limits (tool/state and source clause):
- rule:channel-divinity: character/characterBuild.ts assertSupportedCharacterBuild refuses a second class; source Channel Divinity interaction across classes is deferred (ADR 0018).
- rule:class-features: character/characterBuild.ts assertSupportedCharacterBuild refuses a second class; source class-feature grant on gaining a level in another class (ADR 0018).
- rule:conflict: state/activeEffects.ts addEffect tracks timed charm, while orchestrator/toolAdjustHp.ts adjustHpTool does not trigger the source repeat save when the charmed creature takes damage.
- rule:experience-points: character/characterBuild.ts assertSupportedCharacterBuild refuses split class levels; source example applies XP to total character level across classes (ADR 0018).
- rule:extra-attack: character/characterBuild.ts assertSupportedCharacterBuild refuses a second class; source says multiple Extra Attack grants do not stack (ADR 0018).
- rule:hit-points-and-hit-dice: character/characterBuild.ts assertSupportedCharacterBuild refuses a second class; source mixed-class HP and Hit Dice progression is deferred (ADR 0018).
- rule:multiclassing: character/characterBuild.ts assertSupportedCharacterBuild refuses additional-class selection; source multiclass entry and prerequisites are deferred (ADR 0018).
- rule:multiclassing-proficiency-bonus: character/characterBuild.ts assertSupportedCharacterBuild refuses split class levels; source proficiency bonus uses total character level (ADR 0018).
- rule:special-weapons: orchestrator/toolSpendTurnResource.ts spendTurnResourceTool spends the action without enforcing the source net limit of one attack; toolResolveCheck.ts resolveCheckTool can resolve another.
- rule:spellcasting: character/characterBuild.ts assertSupportedCharacterBuild refuses a second class; source multiclass slot and class-associated spell allocation is deferred (ADR 0018).
- rule:suffocating: orchestrator/toolAdjustHp.ts adjustHpTool and toolStabilizeCharacter.ts stabilizeCharacterTool do not gate HP recovery or stabilization on breathing; source forbids both until breathing resumes.
- rule:unarmored-defense: character/characterBuild.ts assertSupportedCharacterBuild refuses a second class; source excludes a second-class Unarmored Defense grant (ADR 0018).
- rule:weapon-properties: orchestrator/toolResolveCheck.ts resolveCheckTool resolves an ammunition attack without spending inventory; toolRemoveItem.ts removeItemTool needs an explicit call, and loading is not enforced.
Deleted known limits (A3 trap criterion):
- rule:armor-guidance: no live character AC derivation or worn-armor consumer; encounter AC reads creature stat blocks, not this clause.
- rule:crafting: no crafting-progress tool or state; clock and wallet record only selected outputs.
- rule:expenses-lifestyle-expenses: no automatic lifestyle-cost calculation; spend_currency records an already chosen payment.
- rule:practicing-a-profession: no profession-earnings or lifestyle-offset operation; generic clock and wallet do not imply one.
- rule:researching: no research schedule or cost operation; clock and wallet record selected outputs.
- rule:self-sufficiency: no lifestyle-offset consumer; time recording does not imply the offset.
- rule:selling-treasure: no resale-price calculation; gain_currency records already determined proceeds.
- rule:training: no training-progress or cost operation; clock and wallet record selected outputs.
- rule:wizard-your-spellbook: no found-spell copying operation; level-up spell selection is a separate clause.
R0: all 68 retired adjudication rows had no justified positive non-lookup mapping under A3; most were source restatements or generic prose. The three slice rows keep their claims; charges now distinguishes use_item for pack-bound items from generic usage counters for unbound items, as their tool descriptions require. Suffocating preserves the no-stabilization/no-HP-recovery claim; its single source-quoting phrase was paraphrased to satisfy A3 invariant 12 and the permanent eight-word overlap test.
Verification: npm run verify:worktree passed on the committed tree (316 test files passed, 2 documented skipped; 5,566 tests passed, 3 skipped). Source-overlap test took 8 ms in focused run. No discovery or intervention budget changes. No follow-up bead was needed.
